posts.name: Yash Rastogi
posts.cooked:
Apologies, TA doubt clearing sessions will not be recorded. However:

  • Special sessions such as PYQ are likely to be recorded.
  • Instructor-led sessions are recorded.
  • You can always review previously recorded content.

Attending the live session is essential primarily for addressing specific doubts.
